coverage_notes: Exhaustive sweep across 8 products (dbt, SQLMesh, Dataform, Great Expectations, Soda, Elementary, Monte Carlo, Databand) covering transformation tools (lineage DAG visualization) and data quality/observability solutions. Coverage includes: (1) T0 primary sources—official product pages, pricing pages, funding records, press releases; (2) T1 documentation—official docs, release notes, API docs, GitHub repositories; (3) T2 review aggregates (G2, TrustRadius, Capterra reviews), analyst reports (Gartner Magic Quadrant 2026 for Augmented Data Quality, Forrester Wave Q1 2026 Data Quality Solutions), market analysis; (4) T3 practitioner essays, detailed comparisons (Modern DataTools comparisons, Peliqan/Hevodata teardowns), HCI usability research. Deduplication applied: consolidated multiple pricing/comparison sources under single canonical URL per tier. Tiering rationale: live product pages and recent press releases → T0; official vendor docs, changelogs, and GitHub repos → T1; G2/Gartner/Forrester reports and aggregated reviews → T2; third-party comparisons and HN/Medium deep-dives → T3. Named authorities: Gartner, Forrester, G2, CB Insights, TrustRadius, Crunchbase, a16z. Notable gaps: paywalled Gartner reports (noted reference-only), some vendor-specific analyst partnerships (Forrester TEI studies captured via public blogs), detailed column-level HCI studies for data transformation tools are limited in literature. Total sources: 68 deduplicated entries across all products.
